names.note: Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's fifth heading for the Julian 12 February on pravoslavno.rs, „Света Калија.“, with Света left off, which is not a rank. The heading gives no epithet, no city and no rank, so the bare forename is the whole of it; the day's fourth entry declines it as «свете Калије».

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for 12 февраля ст. ст., which is the page for this menologion number.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for 12 februarie, which is the page for this menologion number — not 25 februarie, which merely shares her civil date in 2026.

Not checked: saint.gr's εορτολόγιο for 12 Φεβρουαρίου, which is the page for this menologion number — not 02/25, which merely shares her civil date in 2026. The corpus holds `kale` on the Greek 22 Μαΐου, a charitable woman of a similar name, and nothing was read to connect or separate the two beyond what each page says of itself.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 25.02.2026 (12. фебруар ст. ст.) — „Света Калија.“

attestations.note: The Prologue is the only one of the four calendars read for her, and it is the day's fifth and last entry.
